stem: Which statement describes an example of secondary succession?

options.label: A
options.text: Plant species grow around a volcano following a recent eruption.

options.label: B
options.text: Plant species begin to grow in a forest following a wildfire.

options.label: C
options.text: Plant species begin to grow on rock that was exposed after a landslide.

options.label: D
options.text: Plant species grow where a glacier that has retreated once stood.
